description: Given a Dagster Tableau Cloud integration (TableauCloudWorkspace or a custom resource wrapping the Tableau REST API), convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task under the TABLEAU_CLOUD integration with the correct integration_job (TABLEAU_REFRESH_WORKBOOK vs. TABLEAU_REFRESH_EXTRACT), correctly-named parameters, and credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline.

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster Tableau integration to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/workbook_refresh_workspace.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live refresh, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single TABLEAU_CLOUD task using integration_job TABLEAU_REFRESH_WORKBOOK, with parameters.project_name 'Sales' and parameters.workbook_name 'Sales Dashboard', connection: referencing an Orchestra Tableau Cloud connection rather than the raw connected-app client id/secret/username, and no site_name/pod_name parameter on the task (those live on the connection).

assertions.text: Targets the Sales Dashboard workbook in the Sales project
TABLEAU_CLIENT_ID / TABLEAU_SECRET_ID / TABLEAU_SECRET_VALUE / TABLEAU_USERNAME env var values are not written as literal parameter values in the YAML — they're represented by a connection: reference
site_name and pod_name ('salesteam', '10ax') are not duplicated as task parameters since they belong on the Orchestra connection

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster job to an Orchestra pipeline task, noting it refreshes a published Tableau datasource extract via a hand-rolled REST client rather than dagster-tableau helpers (see files/datasource_extract_custom_resource.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live refresh, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single TABLEAU_CLOUD task using integration_job TABLEAU_REFRESH_EXTRACT, with parameters.project_name 'Finance' and parameters.datasource_name 'Finance Extract', connection: referencing an Orchestra Tableau Cloud connection holding the PAT rather than TABLEAU_PAT_NAME/TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET literal values.

assertions.text: Targets the Finance Extract datasource in the Finance project
The task's parameters do not invent a workbook_name field — this is an extract/datasource refresh, not a workbook refresh, so only project_name and datasource_name are set
No literal PAT name/secret values are written into the YAML — the personal access token is represented via a connection: field

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster code to Orchestra pipeline YAML, preserving the dependency between the two Tableau assets (see files/chained_workbook_and_extract.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live refresh, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: Two TABLEAU_CLOUD tasks sharing one Tableau Cloud connection — a TABLEAU_REFRESH_EXTRACT task for the Marketing Extract datasource, and a TABLEAU_REFRESH_WORKBOOK task for the Marketing Dashboard workbook — with the workbook task's depends_on pointing at the extract task (or its group), reflecting that the dashboard is built on top of the extract and must refresh after it, not before.

assertions.text: At least one depends_on list is populated with a reference rather than left empty everywhere
The dependency direction is correct: the workbook refresh depends on the extract refresh, not the reverse
Both tasks reference the same single Tableau Cloud connection rather than two separately-invented connections
